metadata.description: Rate subagent models vs. expectation, per (model x tier).

plugins.name: model-scorecard
plugins.description: Rate each subagent's output vs. EXPECTATION for that model/task (-2..+2); score is the average per (model x tier) — never a global rank. Free-form hierarchical model names, effort-weighted + stacked complexity views, model-age from knowledge cutoffs, customizable effort config, global data, portable pure-Node core.
